title: Full-System Runtime
plain_reading: The chip can look fast in isolation but lose the benefit to host work, memory movement, or converters.
what_this_supports: A system simulator or runtime estimator can identify whether compute, conversion, memory, or host dispatch is the bottleneck.
what_this_does_not_prove: System simulation does not prove measured board latency.
next_actions: Add ADC and DAC scheduling to runtime estimates.
Compare simulation with later board traces.
